flags.headline: HUT -9.7% on a Q2 revenue and EPS miss, driven by a $94.6M mark-to-market loss on the Bitcoin treasury
flags.detail: Q2 2026 revenue of $72.5M missed the ~$79.75M consensus. Adjusted EBITDA excluding digital-asset mark-to-market was a healthy $10.4M (vs $4.2M prior year), but inclusive of BTC mark-to-market swung to $(94.6)M vs +$221.2M a year ago — GAAP net loss of ~$1.27/share vs an expected ~$0.41 loss. This is a direct hit on two of HUT's own listed key_risks: continued unprofitability with material AI revenue not expected until Q2 2027, and Bitcoin-price-driven earnings volatility. Partial offset: the company added a second 352 MW lease at Beacon Point post-quarter, expanding contracted AI-infrastructure capacity to 949 MW / $26.6B in contracted value — the long-term AI pivot thesis is intact, but near-term earnings quality is weak.
flags.thesis_link: Matches HUT key_risk: 'Q1 2026 net loss... material AI revenue not expected until Q2 2027, creating a 12+ month execution gap' and 'Bitcoin price exposure remains significant... digital asset losses demonstrate the volatility of the crypto treasury strategy.'

evidence.source: Hut 8 Corp — Q2 2026 Results press release (PR Newswire)
Benzinga — Hut 8 Stock Drops Following Q2 Results

flags.headline: EIX persists RED: CEO now warns the Aug 31 wildfire-liability-reform deadline may pass without legislative action, raising real credit-downgrade risk
flags.detail: Stock is down modestly today (-1.15%) but the qualitative risk has escalated: Edison's CEO publicly warned California's legislature may not pass wildfire liability reform before the session ends Aug 31, and that a miss could trigger utility credit downgrades toward non-investment grade. A separate Aug 11 hearing addresses compensation claims from the 2025 LA fire (19 fatalities, 9,400+ structures). ~$1.6B already committed to wildfire settlements.
flags.thesis_link: Matches EIX key_risk: 'Elevated debt-to-equity of 216% amplifies financial risk from future wildfire events, adverse rate case outcomes, or rising interest rates' and 'California's complex regulatory and political environment creates uncertainty around cost recovery... that could compress ROE.'

evidence.source: Seeking Alpha — Edison falls 5% after warning legislature may not act by Aug 31 deadline
Utility Dive — Edison CEO: California utilities face credit downgrades without wildfire reforms
